race.description: Ladbrokes Tote Win +10% In October F&M Mdn Plate
race.comment: SHEMESH (11) makes the most appeal on debut, with a close second in her latest Cranbourne trial, Blake Shinn booked and a deep black-type family that includes G2 Villiers winner Brutality and G3 winner General Salute. She has the profile to run well straight away. HELIZANGEL (10) resumes off a Pakenham trial win and her debut fourth in Open company at Caulfield Heath reads well for this grade, though her heavy-track Sandown-Lakeside run was plain before the spell. PLUCKY ENUFF (5) had no real luck on debut at Seymour, beginning slowly and being held up before closing into fourth, so natural improvement gives her a genuine each-way chance despite another negative barrier draw. GALWAY GIRL (3) has had mixed form at the jumpouts for the Hayes yard and is worth watching the market.
